name: @devdigest/mcp-server
description: DevDigest local stdio MCP server — a pure HTTP client of the already-running local API (http://localhost:3001) that exposes 5 tools (devdigest_list_agents, devdigest_run_agent_on_pr, devdigest_get_findings, devdigest_get_conventions, devdigest_get_blast_radius) to Claude Desktop / Claude Code over stdio.
